subject: Request: latest Hosted API security assessment and secure delivery options
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@dnb-enterprise.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal-ops@dnb-enterprise.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest hosted API security assessment & delivery options

Hi Grace,

We're preparing for our security review with engineering and legal and need the most recent penetration test (and remediation status) for Redwood's Hosted API. Specifically:
- Full pen test report (technical findings) or an executive summary if full disclosure is restricted.
- Current remediation status for any high/critical findings and dates of fixes.
- Confirmation whether any customer data is included or redacted.

We need to understand your secure sharing options (SFTP, presigned object with IP restriction, ephemeral secure portal with audit logs, or other) and any NDA requirements. Our security lead is Tom Becker (cc'd on follow-ups). Legal would like a signed NDA prior to receiving the full report — we can execute quickly via DocuSign.

Can you confirm availability and what you will need from our side (legal contact, IP allowlist, date window for access)? We're ideally looking to complete the review before our vendor risk committee meets on May 5.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Senior Security Program Manager
DNB Enterprise

Attachments: DNB_request_template.xlsx (reference)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@dnb-enterprise.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <legal-ops@dnb-enterprise.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest hosted API security assessment & delivery options

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Looping in our security and compliance leads so they can provide the report and propose secure transfer options. Quick summary of what we can do and what we need from you: 

Options for transfer (pick one):
- Ephemeral secure portal (recommended): 7-day access, MFA, per-user audit logs. We provide a download link once NDA is in place.
- Presigned S3 URL with IP allowlist: one-time password-protected link, TTL 24 hours.
- SFTP with account + IP restriction: 72-hour window.
- Encrypted ZIP (AES-256) via email with password shared by voice or alternate channel.
- Redacted executive summary (no attachments) by email if legal requires minimal exposure.

What we need from DNB:
- Confirmation of preferred transfer method and any IP ranges for allowlist.
- Signed NDA (we can send a Redwood NDA via DocuSign or accept a redline).
- Point of contact for audit/logging (Tom Becker?).

We'll only release the full technical report after NDA signatures and a short intake for access controls. Vivek / Mina — would you share the current remediation snapshot and the typical access workflow for DNB?

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions (Redwood Inference)

--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0142

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@dnb-enterprise.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <legal-ops@redwood-enterprise.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest hosted API security assessment & delivery options

Hi Sarah, Grace — Vivek here from Security. Thanks for the request; happy to coordinate. A concise status and the transfer plan below.

Pen test report status:
- Report: Redwood_HostedAPI_PenTest_20270322_full.pdf (full technical report). We provide a redacted executive summary by default.
- Findings summary: 0 critical open; 2 high (patched 2027-03-15), 4 medium (closed), remainder low/accepted.
- Remediation evidence: remediation tickets, patch dates, and test rechecks are available in the evidence bundle.

Data/redaction note:
- The technical report contains simulated customer payloads and internal example keys that we redact. No actual customer production data is present. We can further sanitize examples if your legal team requests additional redactions.

Recommended transfer workflow (secure & auditable):
1) Execute mutual NDA (we have a DocuSign template ready: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/NDAsignature/abc123).
2) Submit portal access request (REQ-1298) — this creates an ephemeral access token with 1-hour approval TTL for your IPs.
3) Provide desired access window (we typically do 72 hours after approval).
4) We enable access and capture download audit logs; after the window files are auto-purged.

If you prefer presigned S3, we can do a single-GET presigned URL with single-IP restriction and 24h TTL — audit logs will include the HTTP GET and the requesting IP. SFTP is available but requires a short provisioning lead time (1 business day).

Attachments included: Redwood_HostedAPI_PenTest_20270322_summary.pdf (executive summary). The full technical PDF is only released after NDA.

If you confirm NDA + preferred method, Mina and I will provision access. For expedited timeline (access before May 3), please sign the DocuSign today and confirm portal as your preferred transfer mechanism.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: Redwood_HostedAPI_PenTest_20270322_summary.pdf (17 pages, executive summary, redacted)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@dnb-enterprise.com>

Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 23:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest hosted API security assessment & delivery options

Thanks — we signed the mutual NDA this evening (see attached DNB_signed_NDA_20270430.pdf). We'd like to proceed with the ephemeral secure portal option. A few follow-ups: 

- Access window: please enable 72-hour access starting as soon as you provision. Our reviewers will likely access on Monday (May 3).
- IP allowlist: our reviewer IPs are 54.193.12.10 and 34.201.45.88 — please restrict access to those.
- Remediation CSV: can you include a machine-readable remediation checklist (CSV) that lists finding ID, severity, remediation date, status, and verification notes? That helps our intake tooling.

Onboarding notes: Tom Becker will be the primary security reviewer (tom.becker@dnb-enterprise.com). Legal Ops doesn't need separate access to the portal, only a copy of the signed NDA.
